pool.text: Xining was recovered by the Song dynasty and received its new name.
A major earthquake struck Xining measuring at a magnitude of 7.6.
Xining was added to Qinghai and became the new provincial capital.
Japanese warplanes subjected Xining to aerial bombardment during the war.
Municipal status was officially given to the city of Xining.
Ma Bufang bought a piped water system installed in Xining.
A railway link connected Xining station to the Chinese railway network.
The Xining Economic and Technological Development Zone gained state-level approval.
The railway was extended from Xining to reach Lhasa in Tibet.
The World Bank lent funds for river treatment and infrastructure projects.
The Lanzhou-Xinjiang High-Speed Railway opened to serve the city.
The Baoji-Lanzhou high-speed railway connected Xining to the national network.
